name: prepare-for-compact
description: Saves session state before Claude Code compacts: runs the prepare-for-compact skill first, or writes a handoff note when the context is too full for it.

commitWhenAway.title: Commit when away
commitWhenAway.description: When Claude Code compacts an idle session on its own, let the skill commit finished work. Off: it writes the handoff note and commits nothing.
